definitions.historical_spread_proxy: Median Corwin-Schultz estimate from 1H OHLC bars; not observed bid/ask
definitions.median_spread: Median top-of-book quoted spread across repeated live ticker snapshots
definitions.median_turnover: Median platformTurnover24h across repeated live ticker snapshots
definitions.session: Previous NYSE close through 09:30 ET of the target NYSE session
definitions.usable_session: >=80% hourly coverage, nonzero aggregate volume, historical spread proxy <= 20.0 bps
definitions.zero_volume_fraction: Fraction of post-launch completed overnight sessions with aggregate API candle volume equal to zero

split.reason: eligible tradables 4 < 12; common usable sessions 55 < 60 with 30 OOS sessions required
